notes: New Options tab in Panel Settings, holding what the panel SHOWS: clock, weather, layout type, and colours. Window goes back to being about the window — where it is, how big, which screen.

Panel colours can now be changed, and they work. The Text tab could never affect a widget: it writes card values a widget theme does not subscribe to. Accent, bar colour and font have existed in the theme registry since the widget shipped…
Resetting a panel now resets its colours too, instead of leaving the accent exactly as it was.
Corner radius is adjustable from the Window tab.

Switching between the time and a clock face now resizes the panel to suit, and the face grows into place instead of appearing at full size in one frame. Choosing a face also takes effect immediately — it had been waiting for the next…
